items.title: Reconcile the ledger’s version, then publish to @flashynetwork once named
items.detail: Three disagreeing version numbers for one package: this repo’s package.json says 1.0.0; ClaimYour.Gold depends on @flashylabs/ledger@^0.8.0 (below what’s committed, and that name 404s on public npm — only GitHub Packages has it); @flashyos/ledger 1.0.1 is live on public npm, published by hand outside this repo’s own publish.yml, which still only knows how to publish @flashylabs/ledger. @flashynetwork is now claimed on npm (zero packages). Before renaming: pick the one true version (likely 1.0.1, since that’s what’s actually live), update this repo’s package.json and ClaimYour.Gold’s dependency to agree, then point .npmrc and publish.yml at @flashynetwork/ledger directly so the next release comes from CI instead of by hand.
